predecessors.name: Han dynasty
predecessors.text: the land governed from Xuchang, where Cao Cao escorted Emperor Xian in October or early November 196: Cliopatria's Cao Cao shape of 197

successors.name: Cao Wei
successors.text: the realm Cao Cao left, less the Gongsun land and Hanzhong (lost to Liu Bei in 219): Cliopatria's Cao Cao shape of 215 as corrected

rulers.name: Cao Cao
rulers.title: Minister of Works 196-208, Imperial Chancellor 208-220, Duke of Wei 213-216, King of Wei 216-220

rulers.name: Cao Pi
rulers.title: King of Wei, then Emperor Wen of Wei

ledger.x: 196: Cao Cao escorts Emperor Xian to Xuchang.
200: Yuan Shao is beaten at Guandu and withdraws north of the river (page: 'Following his triumph over the warlord Yuan Shao at the Battle of Guandu in 200 AD').
207: the Wuhuan of Liaoxi are broken.
209: the Jing front settles after Zhou Yu takes Jiangling; Cao Cao keeps the north of Jing.
211: Cao Cao moves on the Guanzhong warlords.
211: the coalition is broken at Huayin; the front moves west into Liang Province.
213: Cao Cao is created Duke of Wei.
215: Zhang Lu is overcome; Hanzhong is Cao Cao's.
215: Liang Province (Hexi, Gansu) is in Cliopatria's 215 shape.
216: Cao Cao becomes King of Wei.
219: the Hanzhong campaign ends with Liu Bei in Hanzhong.
220: Cao Pi takes the Han throne and founds the Cao Wei.

wars.name: Battle of Guandu
wars.outcome: Cao Cao's victory over Yuan Shao; no land changed hands, but it opened the conquest of the Yuan lands in 204-207.

wars.name: Cao Cao's conquest of the Yuan lands
wars.outcome: Ye falls in 204, Yuan Tan is killed in spring 205, the Wuhuan and the Yuan brothers are beaten in 207; 'Northern China was basically pacified and unified under Cao Cao's control'.

wars.name: Battle of Red Cliffs
wars.outcome: Cao Cao is beaten by the allied forces of Sun Quan, Liu Bei and Liu Qi; Zhou Yu captures Jiangling in 209 and the three powers divide Jing Province.

wars.name: Battle of Tong Pass (Huayin)
wars.outcome: Cao Cao wins at Huayin and takes the Chang'an area.

wars.name: Hanzhong campaigns
wars.outcome: Cao Cao takes Hanzhong from Zhang Lu in 215; Liu Bei takes it from Cao Cao in 218-219.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a border for the warlord years; the frontiers with Yuan Shao, Liu Biao, Sun Quan and Liu Bei are approximate.
